Be careful!! This app shows a lower Avg buying price from the price you actually bought at, under your Holdings section, in Delivery orders. Effectively u are losing money. Since most Groww users are not exactly regular traders, we dont keep track of the exact price we bought, and Groww cheats its customers this way!!
